edit.description: checkoutAddress folds the commonDir it reports, at the one reporter
the linked-checkout case that reds on the two spellings

summary: checkoutAddress hands back git's `C:/...` spelling of commonDir while every consumer and pin composes the host's, so the fold is missing at the reporter
acceptance: commonDir reaches its consumers in one alphabet, folded where checkoutAddress reports it rather than at any composer, and the linked-checkout case is green on both hosts
notes: Windows-lane red in "separates the primary checkout from a linked one...": `expected 'C:/Users/...' to be 'C:\Users\...'`. commonDir comes out of `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute` verbatim and is a filesystem path, not a pathspec — consumers (entryClaimPath, createWorktree) compose it with node:path. Keep both sides of checkoutSegment's equality on one hand, whichever way the fold goes. No tests[]: on posix the two alphabets coincide, so nothing here reds on the base.
